data.body:
# Concise agent-authored durable text — research record

## Research conclusion

Use preservation-first selective compression, not a naked word cap. Agents should write the minimum sufficient durable record while retaining every fact needed to execute, verify, decide, or resume: objective/current state, constraints and decisions, identifiers, paths, commands, values, evidence, blockers, owner, and next action. Lead with outcome or delta. Remove greetings, narration, repeated context, generic advice, redundant alternatives, and closing restatements. Link canonical detail instead of copying it. Expand only for ambiguity, risk, evidence, or decision rationale.

Generate facts first, then classify each semantic unit KEEP, COMPRESS, or DELETE. Protect dates, versions, paths, commands, measurements, decisions, constraints, blockers, owners, identifiers, and exact errors; verify these survive compression. Use concise positive examples, artifact-specific schemas, progressive disclosure, and complexity-sensitive advisory budgets. State uncertainty as one unknown plus its cheapest discriminating check. Keep internal reasoning and tool narration out of durable records.

## Artifact contract

- Description: problem/outcome, boundaries and constraints, scope, measurable acceptance criteria. Exclude investigation chronology and generic background.
- Plan: one chosen approach, ordered actions/dependencies, risks, and proof. Exclude unselected alternatives and narrated thought process.
- Comment: only the new delta—evidence, decision, blocker, next action/owner. Exclude ticket/history recap and no-op status.
- Handoff: current state, unresolved risks, and exact resumption point. Exclude replay of completed work.
- Session log: verbose chronology, raw or linked evidence, research notes, intermediate observations, and details needed for audit but not for every future executor. Ticket descriptions/plans/comments link here rather than copying it.

## Deterministic rule matrix

Comparison normalization changes only case, whitespace, and list markers; it never rewrites stored text. Code, quoted exact evidence, identifiers, paths, commands, dates, measurements, and exact errors are protected.

1. Exact duplication: normalized prose unit at least 8 words repeats. Flag two copies; block at three copies or at least 15% duplicated unprotected prose. Exempt headings, table headers, checklist markers, code/logs, and versioned normative quotations.
2. Near/cross-history duplication: units at least 20 words, or comment versus description/last five comments, have token 5-shingle Jaccard at least 0.80. Advisory only. Exempt corrections, resolutions, handoffs, and matrices/criteria with distinct protected facts.
3. Transcript dump: at least 20 consecutive shell/log/JSON-like lines, or at least 2,000 transcript characters and over 25% of the artifact. Warn there; block above 50 lines or 4,000 characters without an at-most-100-word finding summary plus durable pointer/hash. Exempt session logs and necessary exact bug/security/incident evidence.
4. Structurally empty update: comment has no non-empty Delta, Evidence, Decision, Blocker, or Next field and fewer than 8 content words with no identifier, metric, link, or command. Blocking. Exempt machine lifecycle events and typed monitoring heartbeats.
5. Filler/meta narration: configurable phrases such as “certainly,” “here is,” “it is important to note,” “as mentioned above,” or “in conclusion.” Flag at three matches or over two per 100 words. Advisory. Exempt quotations and user-facing copy under review.
6. Sentence/paragraph sprawl: sentence over 45 words or prose paragraph over 120 words. Informational/advisory. Exempt code, exact errors, logs, quotations, and legal text.
7. Alternative/hedge sprawl: at least three Option/Alternative blocks or more than three hedge terms per 100 words. Advisory generally; block an executable plan with multiple mutually exclusive paths and no Chosen or Blocked marker. Exempt ideas, ADRs, comparisons, and explicitly blocked discovery.
8. Imperative saturation: MUST/ALWAYS/NEVER exceeds one per ten nonblank lines or 15 total. Advisory. Exempt reasoned safety, compliance, and irreversible-operation constraints.
9. Length envelope: versioned P95 for accepted artifacts in the same type/complexity bucket with at least 200 samples; initial fallback 8,000 description characters, 600 plan words, or 150 comment words. Advisory; an operational admission cap may block without proving bloat. Exempt marked exact evidence, incident/security/legal records, and generated specifications.
10. Canonical-source copying: linked local source plus at least 100 copied words with 7-shingle containment at least 0.50. Advisory. Exempt version-pinned normative excerpts whose exact wording is evidence.

Apply the completeness floor first. Never auto-delete flagged text. Report matched spans and allow reasoned suppression.

## Empirical evidence

- Valid ≠ Necessary (2026, arXiv:2607.11266): CAID combines local redundancy, global goal alignment, information density, and semantic progress; PACE reduced reasoning tokens 31–53% while maintaining accuracy.
- When LLMs Over-Answer (2026, arXiv:2607.17063): 65.7% redundant alternatives and 69.1% padding in the HDL study; core/non-core refinement reduced answer count 37% and non-core length 31% while improving quality.
- The Sleeping Agent (2026, arXiv:2608.11775): an explicit temporal-preservation instruction raised date/time retention from 3.05% to 62.39%.
- What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? (2026, arXiv:2608.16370): unchanged completion can conceal increased state-retrieval work.
- On Problems of Implicit Context Compression for Software Engineering Agents (2026, arXiv:2605.11051): a technique successful on single-shot tasks failed on multi-step coding tasks.
- Published 2025 support: Demystify Verbosity Compensation Behavior (ACL 2025.uncertainlp-main.14); Context Length Alone Hurts (2025.findings-emnlp.1264); Explaining Length Bias (2025.findings-emnlp.358); Token-Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning (2025.findings-acl.1274).

Most 2026 evidence is recent or domain-specific. It supports the architecture—selective compression, protected facts, and downstream evaluation—not universal numeric thresholds.

## OSS evidence

Popular, non-archived, recently pushed sources inspected in September 2026: openai/skills, anthropics/skills, obra/superpowers, wshobson/agents, anthropics/claude-code, and github/awesome-copilot. Convergent practices: every token earns its place; keep load-bearing context; use progressive disclosure and canonical references; prefer concise positive examples; use qualitative/adaptive budgets; statically detect exact repetition and imperative density; scope findings and require confidence. Awesome Copilot’s Caveman Mode illustrates expansion exceptions but its 3–6-word sentences and article dropping are too rigid and are community convention, not official GitHub policy.

## Evaluation design

Measure protected-fact retention, fresh-agent resumption success, rereads/tool calls, and per-rule false positives/negatives. Length, near-duplication, filler, paragraph size, hedging, imperative density, and canonical-copy overlap remain advisory because they cannot prove irrelevance. Match lengths when using LLM judges to avoid length bias.

Calibration work continues on inanimate-unrideable-wasp using multiple blinded background-agent batches of historical work tickets selected at 7,200–7,999 and at least 8,000 description characters.
